events.title: Oil prices rise, stock futures dip after latest flare-up of strikes between U.S. and Iran
events.blurb: Oil prices rose and U.S. stock-index futures slipped on Sunday, after the U.S. and Iran continued their tit-for-tat attacks around the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend.
